name: police-and-control-audit-specs
description: One entry point — `audit-pipeline` — for every Police & Control audit at maids.cc, routing to five specialised skills across the full arc: discover (does the data exist, what does the ERP actually do), specify (spec + UI mockup), execute (write and run the SQL, adjudicate findings, publish or retract), and hand over (DNA/Jira ticket pack). Carries the defects that have cost real rework on both halves: eighteen specification defects, and fourteen worked execution failures with their real before/after numbers. Verdicts are six values, not two — VOID and BLOCKED are not passes.
